summary: Iteration 3 tested: (1) Input Nota now uses Total Harga per item with auto harga/unit, (2) Dashboard Tren Bulanan LineChart via /reports/rekap-bulanan, (3) Expanded Arus Kas with Saldo Awal + new setoran/dana-pengembangan fields and Saldo Akhir = saldo_awal + penambahan - pengeluaran. Backend: updated backend_test.py for new ArusKasInput schema (saldo_awal/pendapatan_lainnya/setoran_ke_kasir|bank|koperasi/belanja_dana_pengembangan) and added test_rekap_bulanan + updated test_arus_kas_report assertions for saldo_akhir and pengeluaran_lain. 26/26 pytest pass. Frontend: Playwright login -> Dashboard LineChart visible -> Input Nota (unit=4, total=20000 shows 'Rp 5.000' per unit and Rp 20.000 item total + total-nota) -> Save -> Laporan Arus Kas tab with saldo_awal=1000000, penjualan=500000, setoran_ke_koperasi=100000 produced Saldo Akhir = Rp 1.380.000 (1000000 + 500000 - (20000 belanja nota + 100000 setoran)) — formula correct.

minor.issue: No validation that sumber_dana exists in master; accepts arbitrary strings (carryover).
Returns 0 (not null) for missing input docs — acceptable, note that saldo_awal defaults to 0 when no input saved.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /reports/arus-kas correctly computes saldo_akhir = saldo_awal + sum(penambahan) - (total_belanja + sum(pengeluaran_lain)). Verified 1,000,000 + 500,000 - 120,000 = 1,380,000 in E2E.
server.py /reports/rekap-bulanan returns 12-month data with pendapatan/belanja per jenis_from_kode; iterates notes once — O(N) fine.
InputNota.js correctly computes harga_per_unit = total/unit on submit; empty/0 unit guarded.
Laporan.js arus kas report uses optional chaining (arusKas?.saldo_awal) so UI doesn't crash when no data.
Dashboard.js adds LineChart with recharts for Tren Bulanan; svg rendering verified.
seed_data_creation: TestReports class fixture creates/deletes TESTR-001 nota. Playwright created one UI nota, cleaned up via API script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 26 tests. ArusKasInput schema fields: saldo_awal, penjualan, penambahan_modal, pendapatan_lainnya, kas_bulan_lalu_belum_disetor, sponsor_sisa, penambahan_lain, setoran_ke_kasir/bank/koperasi, belanja_dana_pengembangan. /reports/arus-kas returns groups[i] with keys: saldo_awal, penambahan{}, jumlah_penambahan, belanja[], total_belanja, pengeluaran_lain{}, jumlah_pengeluaran, saldo_akhir. New endpoint /reports/rekap-bulanan returns {year, data[12], total_pendapatan, total_belanja, saldo}. TestReports has class-scoped autouse fixture _seed_nota because pytest-xdist loadscope distributes classes across workers. Frontend testid for new input: input-total-{idx} (removed input-harga-{idx}).
